verses.text: And these [are] the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.

segments.text: And these [are] the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.

verses.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

segments.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.text: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

segments.text: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

segments.text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

verses.text: From these were separated the coastlands of the nations, in their lands, each according to his tongue, according to their clans, in their nations.

segments.text: From these were separated the coastlands of the nations, in their lands, each according to his tongue, according to their clans, in their nations.

verses.text: And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.

verses.text: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

segments.text: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.text: And Cush begat Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

segments.text: And Cush begat Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

verses.text: He was a mighty hunter before the face of YHWH; upon thus it is said: “Like Nimrod, [a] mighty hunter before the face of YHWH.”

segments.text: He was a mighty hunter before the face of YHWH; upon thus it is said: “Like Nimrod, [a] mighty hunter before the face of YHWH.”

verses.text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

segments.text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.text: From that land he went to Assyria, and he built Nineveh and Rehoboth-ir and Calah,

segments.text: From that land he went to Assyria, and he built Nineveh and Rehoboth-ir and Calah,

verses.text: and Resen between Nineveh and between Calah; it [is] the great city.

segments.text: and Resen between Nineveh and between Calah; it [is] the great city.

verses.text: and Pathrusim, and and Casluhim (from whom the Philistines went out), and Caphtorim.

segments.text: and Pathrusim, and and Casluhim (from whom the Philistines went out), and Caphtorim.

segments.text: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

verses.text: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

verses.text: And the border of the Canaanite was from Sidon as you go toward Gerar, as far as Gaza; as you go toward Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.

verses.text: These [are] the sons of Ham, according to their clans, according to their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.

segments.text: These [are] the sons of Ham, according to their clans, according to their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.

verses.text: And [sons] were also born to Shem—the father of all the sons of Eber—the brother of Japheth the elder.

segments.text: And [sons] were also born to Shem—the father of all the sons of Eber—the brother of Japheth the elder.

verses.text: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

segments.text: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

verses.text: And to Eber two sons were born: The name of the one [was] Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and the name of his brother [was] Joktan.
